summary: Strategy Inc filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement (Supplement No. 1 to its Series A Perpetual Stride Preferred Stock Annex) covering up to $4,133,799,112.67 of its 10.00% STRD preferred stock. The filing merely updates disclosure after stockholders approved an Amended and Restated Certificate of Designations at the October 28, 2026 special meeting, effective January 1, 2027, changing regular dividend payments from quarterly to each business day starting January 4, 2027, with rate and non-cumulative character unchanged. STRD closed at $69.75 on October 30, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation.
